name: Engine Kid
label: Revelation
lede: Seattle straight edge kids who wanted to be Slint recorded in Steve Albini's basement, covered Coltrane for twelve minutes on Revelation, then split. Their guitarist went on to found Southern Lord and Sunn O))).

eras.title: Straight edge kids chasing Slint
eras.text: Greg Anderson came up through Seattle's straight edge bands, Brotherhood and Amenity among them. Engine Kid was meant to sound like none of them: loud-quiet songs built on Slint's Spiderland, in a city busy with grunge.

years.h: Greg Anderson starts a band that won't sound like Seattle
years.p: Anderson on guitar and vocals, Chris Vandebrooke on drums and Art Behrman on bass, all of them veterans of local hardcore and punk bands, want a sound unlike anything they'd played before.
years.xp: Anderson's earlier bands included False Liberty, Brotherhood, Amenity, Statement and Galleon's Lap. Brotherhood and Galleon's Lap both had [[Nate Mendel|ba510f8c-f19d-41a2-921a-53afd27cfcbd]], later bassist in [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]] and the [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]].

years.h: Novocaine 7": Engine Kid press their own first single
years.p: Self-released, and the quiet/loud method is already in place.

years.h: Brian "Krafty" Kraft takes over on bass
years.p: Southern Lord says Kraft's arrival made Engine Kid heavier, darker and far more dynamic.

eras.title: Albini's basement to Bad Animals
eras.text: Two records on Seattle's C/Z in one year, one of them with Steve Albini, then a move to Revelation. A new drummer pushed the band toward metal and jazz, and the last album borrowed horns from Silkworm.

years.p: Five songs, produced by John Goodmanson. Trouser Press wrote that few bands were as shameless about copying Spiderland as Engine Kid.

years.h: Jade Devitt takes the drum stool from Chris Vandebrooke
years.p: Southern Lord calls Devitt "an absolute beast" whose power launched the band "miles beyond where they had ever been."

years.src: Trouser Press · Southern Lord · The Stranger
yt: Live at TT the Bear's Place, Cambridge MA, July 24, 1993
years.h: Bear Catching Fish, recorded by Albini in Chicago
years.p: Engine Kid's first album is cut with [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]], in a Chicago basement according to Trouser Press, and out on C/Z that summer.
years.xp:
Southern Lord's reissue notes say Albini captured the band as "raw, vulnerable and mammoth." By then their influences ran from [[Black Flag|9941a936-196a-4a62-ae53-a69cbc33f20e]] and [[Die Kreuzen|7550b236-f9c2-450c-81a6-fac63bf9d23e]] to Entombed, Carcass and jazz. Trouser Press heard a band whose relationship with Slint had turned "to influence rather than impersonation."

After Chris Vandebrooke's death, The Stranger called Engine Kid perhaps the closest Seattle came to Slint's emotional pull.

years.h: Iceburn and Engine Kid share a Revelation record
years.p: Engine Kid contribute three instrumental pieces, their first release for Revelation, alongside Salt Lake City's [[Iceburn|b3aa7443-5572-4c1f-99e5-a91e13cd3e5b]].
years.xp: Southern Lord describes the split as instrumental jazz-fusion pieces, recorded in early 1994. It was the first sign Engine Kid were leaving the Slint blueprint behind.

years.p: While still in Engine Kid, Greg Anderson meets [[Stephen O'Malley|d2db31eb-4469-4e8d-8ed2-b3c1bfff0c17]], and the two join Seattle death-doom band [[Thorr's Hammer|31c2d9e6-5f45-4b4e-9af1-aa46bbe3d4f9]], fronted by Norwegian singer Runhild Gammelsæter.

years.h: Angel Wings closes with twelve minutes of Coltrane
years.p: Recorded at Bad Animals in downtown Seattle with John Goodmanson, Engine Kid's last album ends on a cover of John Coltrane's Olé, with Joel Phelps on sax and Tim Midgett on trumpet, both of Silkworm.
years.xp:
Bill Herzog plays upright bass on the Coltrane piece, which appears on vinyl only. Trouser Press called the album "a titanic, punishing wall-of-oomph" and picked the instrumental Nailgun as a standout.

Jade Devitt later said preparing for the session showed him what it felt like to be a complete musician.

years.cap: Flyer for Iceburn, Engine Kid, Farside and Mean Season at Viva Las Vegas, Orange, California, July 1, 1995
yt: Full set, Fireside Bowl, Chicago, July 23, 1995
years.h: Four years of touring end soon after Angel Wings
years.p: Southern Lord says Engine Kid break up very shortly after the album comes out. A July 1995 flyer from Orange, California, shows them still on the road with Iceburn.
years.xp:
Members of [[The Obsessed|aa043c18-c0a0-4cbe-bda0-8541f1fe59bd]] in Los Angeles had seen Engine Kid play and liked where Anderson's taste was heading. Their jams became [[Goatsnake|ae720a02-629e-4e9b-98e7-d1f637bd5a49]]. With Stephen O'Malley, Anderson also formed [[Burning Witch|e5d4491d-1496-4efa-a5b9-e7be001b9f6a]] after Thorr's Hammer ended.

Two fan-shot full sets survive from that last summer: the Fireside Bowl in Chicago on July 23 and EJ's in Portland on June 24.

eras.title: A label called Southern Lord
eras.text: Anderson's next move made Engine Kid's afterlife a footnote to something bigger: the label that would put out Sunn O))), and in time every Engine Kid record.

years.h: Anderson and O'Malley found Southern Lord
years.p: The label for doom, sludge, drone and crust becomes home to their own band, [[Sunn O)))|1d3da898-4fb4-4445-b704-cd7315e01789]]. Two decades on, it reissues Engine Kid's whole catalog.

eras.title: A drummer lost, a vault opened
eras.text: The death of Engine Kid's first drummer brought old friends together, and Southern Lord went back into the tapes: charity remasters, a six-LP box and a song nobody remembered recording.

years.h: Chris Vandebrooke is killed in Griffith Park
years.p: Engine Kid's original drummer, later of Fairgrove, dies in Los Angeles. Southern Lord says he was murdered near a homeless encampment by the LA River.
years.xp: The Stranger described him as a respected, talented drummer who led an untraditional life. As of its January 2017 story, the LAPD had released no further details about the investigation; Seattle friends were planning a memorial show.

years.h: Bandcamp Day remasters go to LA's Midnight Mission
years.p: Southern Lord posts Brad Boatright's remasters of Bear Catching Fish and Angel Wings as pay-what-you-want, all proceeds to the shelter in Vandebrooke's honor.

years.big: The reason it was left off the full-length album remains a mystery!
years.h: Six LPs, and a lost Angel Wings track
years.p: Greg Anderson on Angel Dust, found on the master tapes and mixed by Brad Wood for the Southern Lord Record Store Day box Everything Left Inside, which remasters every Engine Kid record.

years.h: Angel Wings turns 30 as a deluxe double LP
years.p: Southern Lord reissues the last album as a remastered 2xLP in a gatefold jacket. Brian Kraft says it doesn't sound a day older than 25.
